entry.title: Nosy Alañaña Light
entry.note: Native+Z entrance points north-northeast at heading2.7rad. Inspected north-up Google satellite view shows the projecting canopy/parallel steps on the north-northeast octagonal base, toward the northern keeper compound, rather than the southern slab. APMF2020 entrance photo identifies those forms. Bearing is approximate ±20degrees: trees/parallax/low image resolution preclude a surveyed azimuth; imagery acquisition date is unavailable. Static concrete-tower exterior using2006/2020/2023 research. APMF publishes60m height;7.1m base flats, window spacing, gallery/consoles and canopy are photo-proportioned. Pale lower shaft/dark upper band represents the older documented paint design through common plaster; variable heavy2023 staining is not copied as a texture. Interior stair, lamp operation, detached keeper buildings, foliage and current restoration condition are outside scope. Skyline keeps dark window marks; all near levels retain sixteen actual recessed arch openings. Original source builder remains preserved; source-local reviewed geometry connects the stair landing and exposes the wooden door in front of its backing. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
